## History

Miss Rogerson was a middle-aged lady who had taught a Sunday-school class for twenty years. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended Sunday-school alone, she was placed in Miss Rogerson's class, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) felt out of place.
